output.title: South-Facing One-Bedroom Apartment with Storage in Bonnevoie
output.description:
This 52 m² apartment offers a practical living space in the central neighborhood of Bonnevoie. The living room features a bright south-facing window that provides ample natural light, complemented by laminate flooring and neutral white walls, creating a clean and welcoming atmosphere.

The kitchen is arranged in a compact galley layout with white cabinetry and ceramic tile flooring. Though traditional in style, it presents a functional space suitable for everyday meal preparation.

The bathroom is well-maintained and includes a full-size tub with a shower, finished with white tiles and equipped with a single vanity. This unit also includes a dedicated storage area, an advantageous feature in the urban setting.

Located in a lively and multicultural district known for its diverse dining options and popular market, this apartment is close to convenient transit connections including the central station. Bonnevoie offers a vibrant environment with more affordable pricing compared to other central areas.
